title: Australian Public AI Register
description:
An open, provenance-gated dataset of Australian public-sector artificial intelligence and migration. Covers government AI contracts, public-sector AI hiring, data centre investment, net overseas migration by visa group, and party technology policy positions.

Every row carries the URL it was retrieved from, the retrieval timestamp, and a source tier distinguishing public records from company claims. A continuous integration gate rejects any row with missing provenance or a bare-homepage source URL.

Compiled from the Australian Bureau of Statistics Data API, the Department of Home Affairs, AusTender and Hansard.
